st: Nella in Bowling Land/A Tricksy Wedding
d: When Olivia's sparkly ball is lost in the bowling lanes, Nella and friends venture into a bowling wonderland beyond the pins to get it back./While Nella and the gang prepare for Garrett's dad's wedding, Tricksy swaps the ring for something silly.

st: Just Another Manic Mud Day/Best Friends Forever
d: When Nella invites Gork's cousin to their Mud Day celebration, Gork does everything he can to impress him./When Nella and Trinket want to do different things, they begin to question their friendship.

st: Knights of the Sparkly Table/Knights to the Rescue
d: Nella and her friends are sent on a mysterious quest by Nella's Aunt Whinnie to unlock a knightly surprise./When Nella and her friends all get new knightly tools, Blaine is worried that his isn't as good as the others.

st: Winning Friends/Willow Gets to the Root of It
d: Nella meets her match at Castlehaven's Friendship Games, when a new friend becomes determined to win at any cost./When Nella's clubhouse tree loses its luster, Nella and her friends must get to the root of the problem.

st: Freezing Out the Fleagles/The Big Concert
d: Nella must save Castlehaven from a surprise blizzard before it freezes her entire kingdom./When Nella's music idol comes to town to give a concert, there aren't enough tickets for everyone.

st: The Tooth Fairy Tale/Tough Break for Garrett
d: When the Tooth Fairy doesn't arrive in Castlehaven, Nella investigates her mysterious disappearance./With his arm in a cast, Garrett must find a new way to be a hero on an urgent knightly quest.

Nella and Trinket's perfect tea party goes wrong when they accidentally use boingy-berries in their muffins./When Nella and Riley are asked to rock-sit, they don't realize the importance of their mission.

When Nella invites a group of lost Chomplings to a knightly sleepover, Blaine thinks they're cramping his style... until he realizes they've lost their home./Nella must rescue Blaine when his tall-tales get him in big trouble.
Riley secretly enlists the help of a music loving dragon to play a duet with Nella at a big recital./Dwayne is nervous about going on his first quest as Blaine's steed.

st: Cici Saves the Day/Big Little Rides
d: Nella helps Cici learn how to stand up and stand out when Tricksy tries to steal a sparkly trophy./Worried that he won't fit in, a giant ogre shrinks himself using a magical wishing wagon.

st: Piece of Cake/A Tale of Two Nellas
d: Nella journeys to Riley's kingdom in search of a special glowfruit for King Dad's surprise birthday cake./When Gork dresses as Nella for a costume party, a tricky villain mistakes him for the real princess knight.

Nella helps her family get to an important sports tournament, and proves she's ready for big things along the way./Nella invites Riley on a tour of Castlehaven, but Riley becomes more interested in winning a photo contest instead.

st: The Great Sparkle Quest/Twinkle Twinkle Family Vacation
d: When Castlehaven loses its sparkle, Nella and the Knights of the Sparkly Table face their toughest challenge ever./Nella's family vacation to Lake Twinkle is jeopardized when a tricky villain makes off with the source of its twinkle.
The Fresh Beats are out of school and they want to do something fun.
When the Fresh Beats bring a plant indoors and start singing scat to it, the plant grows and takes over the lobby.
A pink balloon wants to play with the Fresh Beats.
The Fresh Beats decide to order a new car online.  However, when it's delivered, it comes in 57 boxes and they can't figure out how to put it together.
It's summer and the Fresh Beats are going camping and hoping to spot a shooting star.
When the circus only half-arrives, the Fresh Beats jump in to help save it for the Junior Beats.
When it starts raining, Twist, Shout and Kiki run for cover.  But the rhythm-of-the-rain sound inspires Marina to write a new song.
The Fresh Beats want to do a basketball dance but Shout can't do his super-fast move right. So they build presto pants to help them.

It's their first day back at music school and the Fresh Beats reminisce about their favorite songs. They can't decide on just one song, so they decide to make a brand new, awesome back-to-school song.

st: The Case of the Missing Violin
d: Kiki's favorite violin duo, Nuttin' But Stringz, invites the Fresh Beats to perform with them. But when Kiki's favorite violin is missing, the Fresh Beats follow the clues to solve the mystery of her missing violin.
The Fresh Beats are graduating from Music School! Everyone dreams of doing new things after graduation, but what does Marina want to do? And does this mean the end of the band?
The Fresh Beats need to help their new friend Harper at his Singing Pizza Café when their concert attracts more customers than he can handle! Will Twist's giant pizza plan save the day.
The Fresh Beats must don the costumes of their favorite heroes, The Mighty Music Band, to defeat the evil Deep Freeze, who's freezing everyone in an attempt to stop them from dancing!
DJ Twist is ready to rock the turntables at the pool party, but he'll need help from Kiki, Marina, and Shout to refill the pool after they accidentally splash all the water out of it!
When the Fresh Beats use a giant blender to make snow for their winter show, they end up covering the entire town! How will they dig their way out of this one? Ice skating, anyone?
When the Fresh Beats get transported right into their Rock Star board game, they'll need to work together with their friends to play a riff on a giant keyboard so they can return home!

The Fresh Beats order four robot versions of themselves to help them pick berries for Melody and make pizzas for Harper. But when the robots make a big mess, the Fresh Beats have to figure out how to clean up their mess.

The Fresh Beats help their friend Harper babysit a pair of chimps who are more than they can handle. Marina gets the idea to build a jungle gym for the chimps in the park and the Fresh Beats find a perfect song to rock the show.
When a new ballet comes to town, Kiki is cast in the lead as the Pink Swan! She'll need help from the other Fresh Beats to learn to do five turns in a row … and to figure out how to stop!
The Fresh Beats are going to rock the half-time show at the Junior Beats' first basketball game, but it's the Junior Beats who rock on their new court when they play against the Fresh Beats!
The Fresh Beats meet a magical genie and try to use their wishes to put on a great concert at the Indian festival. But the genie helps the Fresh Beats realize that all they need is each other!

st: Yo! Fresh Beats Go Gabba Gabba!
d: The Fresh Beats meet the Gabba Land gang when Plex beams DJ Lance and friends into the Singing Pizza Café!
When the Fresh Beats are asked to play in a western town, they find that they need to face off against a ghost band! Will they be able to put on a show and bring folks back to the town?
When Twist is recruited to be a rap superstar, he realizes he doesn't want to leave the Fresh Beats! Luckily, Marina, Shout, and Kiki have a prehistoric plan to reunite with him!
